m.t: Entonces sabes que ella es la única que puede activar la llama.
m.e: Then you know she's the only one who can activate the Flame.

m.t: Voy a activar la puerta y luego la abres.
m.e: I'll trip the door and then you gun it.

m.e: Activating my father's network will.

m.e: I'll wait till the very last second before I activate the venom.

m.e: Now, you can also trigger the alarm by using this app right here.
